name: AIToolkit FlowMatch Sampler
plain: Rebuilds an ai-toolkit trainer's sigma list for inference, by a formula path or an exact path that imports the toolkit's scheduler if present. Config table per model holds shift values.
math:
t=linspace(1,1/n,n) (force_aitk_timesteps) or linspace(1,0,n+1)[:-1].
Resolution-aware: L=(w//16)(h//16), μ=line(L), σ=dynamic shift(μ,t). Else static shift.
Optional final 0.

props.params: model_type, steps, width, height, shift, resolution_aware, force_aitk_timesteps, append_zero
